title: Reduce community malaria transmission through vaccination

concept.text: Vaccinate infectious human populations to reduce onward transmission and incident infections in the community. Pfs230D1 clinical studies demonstrate functional transmission-blocking signals, but these are not yet proof of community-level protection. Proposed completion test: WHO recommendation for transmission reduction, supported by a cluster-randomized endemic-area trial showing fewer incident human infections over at least two transmission seasons, with a prespecified efficacy confidence interval excluding no benefit. Test set by: WHO PPC: 'reduction of incident human infections at the community level.' Cluster design, two-season duration and statistical boundary are proposed operational criteria. Overlaps: INF-04, INF-13. Sources given: [WHO transmission-reducing vaccine PPC](https://www.who.int/tools/target-product-profile-database/item/ppc--for-vaccines-to-reduce-malaria-transmission) ; [Primary Pfs230D1 clinical trial publication](https://media.malariaworld.org/A_Vaccine_to_Block_Plasmodium_falciparum_Transmission_b57ee04012.pdf).
